# Probe scripts (subject -> ACI tables). Each starts a throwaway container from deploy/docker/dirsrv.digest with a random Directory Manager password.

===== script filterprobe8.py =====
import subprocess as sp, time, secrets
ref=open('deploy/docker/dirsrv.digest').read().strip()
pw=secrets.token_hex(16); n='muse-fprobe8-'+secrets.token_hex(3)
def ex(*a, inp=None): return sp.run(['docker','exec','-i',n,*a],input=inp,capture_output=True,text=True)
sp.run(['docker','run','-d','--name',n,'-e','DS_DM_PASSWORD='+pw,'-v','/data',ref],stdout=sp.DEVNULL,check=True)
S='dc=example,dc=test'; B='ou=probe-fattr,'+S; P='ou=people,'+S
def who(u): return f'uid={u},{P}'
try:
  for i in range(600):
    l=sp.run(['docker','logs',n],capture_output=True,text=True)
    if '389-ds-container started.' in l.stdout+l.stderr: break
    time.sleep(0.5)
  print('image',ref); print('backend',ex('dsconf','localhost','backend','create','--suffix',S,'--be-name','userroot','--create-suffix').returncode)
  RSC='read,search,compare'
  acis={
   'p_userid':[('(targetattr="userid")',RSC)],
   'p_userid_sn':[('(targetattr="userid")',RSC),('(targetattr="sn")',RSC)],
   'p_userid_snsearch':[('(targetattr="userid")',RSC),('(targetattr="sn")','search')],
   'p_userid_snread':[('(targetattr="userid")',RSC),('(targetattr="sn")','read')],
   'p_star_search':[('(targetattr="*")','search')],
   'p_star_read':[('(targetattr="*")','read')],
   'p_list':[('(targetattr="uid || sn")',RSC)],
   'p_list_nospace':[('(targetattr="uid||sn")',RSC)],
   'p_list_case':[('(targetattr="UID || Sn")',RSC)],
   'p_oid_sn':[('(targetattr="2.5.4.4 || uid")',RSC)],
   'p_oid_only':[('(targetattr="0.9.2342.19200300.100.1.1")',RSC)],
   'p_deny_oid':[('(targetattr!="0.9.2342.19200300.100.1.1")',RSC)],
   'p_deny_list':[('(targetattr!="uid || description")',RSC)],
  }
  ldif=f"dn: {P}\nobjectClass: organizationalUnit\nou: people\n\n"
  for s in acis: ldif+=f"dn: {who(s)}\nobjectClass: inetOrgPerson\nuid: {s}\ncn: {s}\nsn: S\nuserPassword: Probe-Pw-{s}-1\n\n"
  ldif+=f"dn: {B}\nobjectClass: organizationalUnit\nou: probe-fattr\n\n"
  for u,extra in [('fa_alice',''),('fa_bob','uid;x-test: bobtag\ndescription;lang-en: hello\n'),('fa_carol','description;lang-en;x-foo: multi\n')]:
    ldif+=f"dn: uid={u},{B}\nobjectClass: inetOrgPerson\nuid: {u}\ncn: {u}\nsn: S\n{extra}\n"
  r=ex('ldapadd','-x','-H','ldap://127.0.0.1:3389','-D','cn=Directory Manager','-w',pw,inp=ldif); print('add',r.returncode,r.stderr.strip()[:300])
  mod=f"dn: {S}\nchangetype: modify\nadd: aci\n"
  for s,lst in acis.items():
    for k,(t,perm) in enumerate(lst): mod+=f'aci: (target="ldap:///{B}"){t}(version 3.0; acl "labldap:{s}-{k}"; allow ({perm}) userdn="ldap:///{who(s)}";)\n'

  r=ex('ldapmodify','-x','-H','ldap://127.0.0.1:3389','-D','cn=Directory Manager','-w',pw,inp=mod+"\n"); print('aci',r.returncode,r.stderr.strip()[:300])
  O='0.9.2342.19200300.100.1.1'
  fl=['(!(userid;x-test=bobtag))',f'(!({O};x-test=bobtag))','(sn=S)','(!(sn=X))','(uid=fa_bob)','(!(uid=fa_bob))','(cn=fa_bob)','(!(cn=fa_bob))','(2.5.4.4=S)','(description=hello)','(!(description=hello))']
  subs=[('DM','cn=Directory Manager',pw)]+[(s,who(s),f'Probe-Pw-{s}-1') for s in acis]
  for name,dn,p in subs:
    for f in fl:
      r=ex('ldapsearch','-x','-LLL','-H','ldap://127.0.0.1:3389','-D',dn,'-w',p,'-b',B,'-s','one',f,'1.1')
      dns=sorted(l.split(',')[0][4:] for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if l.startswith('dn:'))
      print(f"{name:16} {f:44} rc={r.returncode} {dns} {r.stderr.strip()[:80]}")
    r=ex('ldapsearch','-x','-LLL','-H','ldap://127.0.0.1:3389','-D',dn,'-w',p,'-b',B,'-s','one','(!(userid;x-test=bobtag))','cn')
    print(f"{name:16} (!(userid;x-test=bobtag)) attrs=cn -> {sorted(l for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if l)} rc={r.returncode}")
    r=ex('ldapsearch','-x','-LLL','-H','ldap://127.0.0.1:3389','-D',dn,'-w',p,'-b','uid=fa_bob,'+B,'-s','base','(objectClass=*)','uid','sn','cn','description')
    print(f"{name:16} READ fa_bob uid,sn,cn,description -> {[l for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if l and not l.startswith('dn:')]} rc={r.returncode}")
finally:
  sp.run(['docker','rm','-f','-v',n],capture_output=True)

===== script filterprobe10.py =====
import subprocess as sp, time, secrets
ref=open('deploy/docker/dirsrv.digest').read().strip()
pw=secrets.token_hex(16); n='muse-fprobe10-'+secrets.token_hex(3)
def ex(*a, inp=None): return sp.run(['docker','exec','-i',n,*a],input=inp,capture_output=True,text=True)
sp.run(['docker','run','-d','--name',n,'-e','DS_DM_PASSWORD='+pw,'-v','/data',ref],stdout=sp.DEVNULL,check=True)
S='dc=example,dc=test'; B='ou=probe-fattr,'+S; P='ou=people,'+S
def who(u): return f'uid={u},{P}'
try:
  for i in range(600):
    l=sp.run(['docker','logs',n],capture_output=True,text=True)
    if '389-ds-container started.' in l.stdout+l.stderr: break
    time.sleep(0.5)
  print('image',ref); print('backend',ex('dsconf','localhost','backend','create','--suffix',S,'--be-name','userroot','--create-suffix').returncode)
  RSC='read,search,compare'
  RSC='read,search,compare'
  U=('(targetattr="userid")',RSC)
  acis={'q_oc':[U,('(targetattr="objectClass")','read')]}
  for x in ['creatorsName','modifiersName','createTimestamp','modifyTimestamp','nsUniqueId','entryUUID','entrydn','parentid','entryid','aci','numSubordinates']:
    acis['q_'+x.lower()]=[U,(f'(targetattr="{x}")','read')]

  ldif=f"dn: {P}\nobjectClass: organizationalUnit\nou: people\n\n"
  for s in acis: ldif+=f"dn: {who(s)}\nobjectClass: inetOrgPerson\nuid: {s}\ncn: {s}\nsn: S\nuserPassword: Probe-Pw-{s}-1\n\n"
  ldif+=f"dn: {B}\nobjectClass: organizationalUnit\nou: probe-fattr\n\n"
  for u,extra in [('fa_alice',''),('fa_bob','uid;x-test: bobtag\ndescription;lang-en: hello\n'),('fa_carol','description;lang-en;x-foo: multi\n')]:
    ldif+=f"dn: uid={u},{B}\nobjectClass: inetOrgPerson\nuid: {u}\ncn: {u}\nsn: S\n{extra}\n"
  r=ex('ldapadd','-x','-H','ldap://127.0.0.1:3389','-D','cn=Directory Manager','-w',pw,inp=ldif); print('add',r.returncode,r.stderr.strip()[:300])
  def addaci(text):
    r=ex('ldapmodify','-x','-H','ldap://127.0.0.1:3389','-D','cn=Directory Manager','-w',pw,inp=f"dn: {S}\nchangetype: modify\nadd: aci\naci: {text}\n\n")
    return r.returncode, r.stderr.strip().replace('\n',' ')[:160]
  for s_,lst in acis.items():
    for k,(t,perm) in enumerate(lst):
      print('aci',s_,k,*addaci(f'(target="ldap:///{B}"){t}(version 3.0; acl "labldap:{s_}-{k}"; allow ({perm}) userdn="ldap:///{who(s_)}";)'))
  for t in ['uid|sn','uid ||sn',' uid || sn ','fooBar','1.2.3.4','2.5.4.4','0.9.2342.19200300.100.1.1','uid;x-test','userid','uid || fooBar','UID']:
    print('SYNTAX',repr(t),*addaci(f'(target="ldap:///{B}")(targetattr="{t}")(version 3.0; acl "labldap:syn"; allow (read) userdn="ldap:///cn=nobody,{S}";)'))
  O='0.9.2342.19200300.100.1.1'
  fl=['(!(userid;x-test=bobtag))','(sn=S)','(uid=fa_bob)']
  subs=[('DM','cn=Directory Manager',pw)]+[(s,who(s),f'Probe-Pw-{s}-1') for s in acis]
  for name,dn,p in subs:
    for f in fl:
      r=ex('ldapsearch','-x','-LLL','-H','ldap://127.0.0.1:3389','-D',dn,'-w',p,'-b',B,'-s','one',f,'1.1')
      dns=sorted(l.split(',')[0][4:] for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if l.startswith('dn:'))
      print(f"{name:16} {f:44} rc={r.returncode} {dns} {r.stderr.strip()[:80]}")
    r=ex('ldapsearch','-x','-LLL','-H','ldap://127.0.0.1:3389','-D',dn,'-w',p,'-b','uid=fa_bob,'+B,'-s','base','(objectClass=*)','+')

===== script filterprobe13.py =====
import subprocess as sp, time, secrets, re
ref=open('deploy/docker/dirsrv.digest').read().strip()
pw=secrets.token_hex(16); n='muse-fprobe13-'+secrets.token_hex(3)
def ex(*a, inp=None): return sp.run(['docker','exec','-i',n,*a],input=inp,capture_output=True,text=True)
sp.run(['docker','run','-d','--name',n,'-e','DS_DM_PASSWORD='+pw,'-v','/data',ref],stdout=sp.DEVNULL,check=True)
S='dc=example,dc=test'; B='ou=probe-vis13,'+S; P='ou=people,'+S
def who(u): return f'uid={u},{P}'
def lm(ldif): r=ex('ldapmodify','-x','-a','-c','-H','ldap://127.0.0.1:3389','-D','cn=Directory Manager','-w',pw,inp=ldif); return r.returncode, r.stderr.strip()[:120]
try:
  for i in range(600):
    l=sp.run(['docker','logs',n],capture_output=True,text=True)
    if '389-ds-container started.' in l.stdout+l.stderr: break
    time.sleep(0.5)
  print('image',ref); print('backend',ex('dsconf','localhost','backend','create','--suffix',S,'--be-name','userroot','--create-suffix').returncode)
  r=ex('ldapsearch','-x','-LLL','-o','ldif-wrap=no','-H','ldap://127.0.0.1:3389','-D','cn=Directory Manager','-w',pw,'-b','cn=schema','-s','base','(objectClass=*)','attributeTypes')
  for name in ['memberOf','nsAccountLock','pwdChangedTime','passwordHistory','pwdUpdateTime','passwordExpirationTime']:
    for line in r.stdout.splitlines():
      if re.search(r"NAME \(?\s*'"+name+"'",line,re.I):
        u=re.search(r'USAGE (\w+)',line); nm=re.search(r'NO-USER-MODIFICATION',line)
        print('schema',name,'USAGE',u.group(1) if u else 'userApplications(default)','NO-USER-MOD' if nm else '')
  acis={'q_userid_memberof':'memberOf','q_userid_acctlock':'nsAccountLock'}
  ldif=f"dn: {P}\nobjectClass: organizationalUnit\nou: people\n\ndn: {B}\nobjectClass: organizationalUnit\nou: probe-vis13\n\n"
  ldif+=f"dn: uid=v_m,{B}\nobjectClass: inetOrgPerson\nobjectClass: inetUser\nuid: v_m\ncn: v_m\nsn: S\nmemberOf: cn=g,{S}\n\n"
  ldif+=f"dn: uid=v_l,{B}\nobjectClass: inetOrgPerson\nuid: v_l\ncn: v_l\nsn: S\nnsAccountLock: true\n\n"
  for s in acis: ldif+=f"dn: {who(s)}\nobjectClass: inetOrgPerson\nuid: {s}\ncn: {s}\nsn: S\nuserPassword: Probe-Pw-{s}-1\n\n"
  print('add',*lm(ldif))
  for s,a in acis.items():
    for k,(t,perm) in enumerate([('(targetattr="userid")','read,search,compare'),(f'(targetattr="{a}")','read')]):
      print('aci',s,k,*ex('ldapmodify','-x','-H','ldap://127.0.0.1:3389','-D','cn=Directory Manager','-w',pw,inp=f"dn: {S}\nchangetype: modify\nadd: aci\naci: (target=\"ldap:///{B}\"){t}(version 3.0; acl \"labldap:{s}-{k}\"; allow ({perm}) userdn=\"ldap:///{who(s)}\";)\n\n").returncode.__str__().split())
  for name,dn,p in [('DM','cn=Directory Manager',pw)]+[(s,who(s),f'Probe-Pw-{s}-1') for s in acis]:
    for f in ['(!(userid;x-test=x))']:
      r=ex('ldapsearch','-x','-LLL','-H','ldap://127.0.0.1:3389','-D',dn,'-w',p,'-b',B,'-s','one',f,'1.1')
      dns=sorted(l.split(',')[0][4:] for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if l.startswith('dn:'))
      print(f"{name:18} {f:28} rc={r.returncode} {dns}")
    r=ex('ldapsearch','-x','-LLL','-H','ldap://127.0.0.1:3389','-D',dn,'-w',p,'-b',B,'-s','one','(objectClass=*)','memberOf','nsAccountLock')
    print(f"{name:18} READ memberOf,nsAccountLock -> {[l for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if l]} rc={r.returncode}")
finally:
  sp.run(['docker','rm','-f','-v',n],capture_output=True)

===== script filterprobe15.py =====
import subprocess as sp, time, secrets, re
ref=open('deploy/docker/dirsrv.digest').read().strip()
pw=secrets.token_hex(16); n='muse-fprobe15-'+secrets.token_hex(3)
sp.run(['docker','run','-d','--name',n,'-e','DS_DM_PASSWORD='+pw,'-v','/data',ref],stdout=sp.DEVNULL,check=True)
try:
  for i in range(600):
    l=sp.run(['docker','logs',n],capture_output=True,text=True)
    if '389-ds-container started.' in l.stdout+l.stderr: break
    time.sleep(0.5)
  print('image',ref)
  r=sp.run(['docker','exec',n,'ldapsearch','-x','-LLL','-o','ldif-wrap=no','-H','ldap://127.0.0.1:3389','-D','cn=Directory Manager','-w',pw,'-b','cn=schema','-s','base','(objectClass=*)','attributeTypes'],capture_output=True,text=True)
  usage={}
  for line in r.stdout.splitlines():
    m=re.search(r"NAME (\(([^)]*)\)|'([^']*)')",line)
    if not m: continue
    names=re.findall(r"'([^']+)'",m.group(1)); u=re.search(r'USAGE (\w+)',line)
    for nm in names: usage[nm.lower()]=u.group(1) if u else 'userApplications'
  # Native list: attribute types (OID: "...", Name: "...") in schema_registry.go, run from the repo root.
  reg=[(m.group(1),'op' if 'Operational: true' in m.group(0) else 'user') for m in re.finditer(r'\{OID: "[0-9.]+", Name: "([^"]+)"[^\n]*', open('internal/ldapserver/schema_registry.go').read())]
  for nm,nat in reg:
    o=usage.get(nm.lower(),'ABSENT')
    flag='' if (o=='ABSENT' or (o=='userApplications')==(nat=='user')) else '  <-- differs'
    print(f'{nm:28} native={nat:5} 389={o}{flag}')
finally:
  sp.run(['docker','rm','-f','-v',n],capture_output=True)

# Probes 16-20 (2026-10-04, CAND-33/34/35 resolution): targetattr schema check and options (16), 389 attributeTypes (17, output is internal/schema389/attributetypes.txt), modify/modrdn with omitted targetattr and attribute-scoped write denies (18), absolute filters, -oid placeholders and empty options (19), userid storage and empty filter options (20; 20b sends raw BER because libldap rejects 'cn;' client-side).

===== script filterprobe16.py =====
import subprocess as sp, time, secrets, re
ref=open('deploy/docker/dirsrv.digest').read().strip()
pw=secrets.token_hex(16); n='muse-fprobe16-'+secrets.token_hex(3)
def ex(*a, inp=None): return sp.run(['docker','exec','-i',n,*a],input=inp,capture_output=True,text=True)
sp.run(['docker','run','-d','--name',n,'-e','DS_DM_PASSWORD='+pw,'-v','/data',ref],stdout=sp.DEVNULL,check=True)
S='dc=example,dc=test'; B='ou=probe-fattr,'+S; P='ou=people,'+S
def who(u): return f'uid={u},{P}'
H=['-H','ldap://127.0.0.1:3389']
def red(t): return re.sub(r'(userPassword[^:]*::?) .*', r'\1 <redacted>', t)
try:
  for i in range(600):
    l=sp.run(['docker','logs',n],capture_output=True,text=True)
    if '389-ds-container started.' in l.stdout+l.stderr: break
    time.sleep(0.5)
  print('image',ref); print('backend',ex('dsconf','localhost','backend','create','--suffix',S,'--be-name','userroot','--create-suffix').returncode)
  RSC='read,search,compare'
  acis={
    # CAND-34: options inside targetattr
    't_uidopt':[('(targetattr="uid;x-test")',RSC)],
    't_descopt':[('(targetattr="description;lang-en")',RSC),('(targetattr="objectClass || sn")','read,search')],
    'd_uidopt':[('(targetattr="*")',RSC),('(targetattr="uid;x-test")','DENY'+RSC)],
    'w_descopt':[('(targetattr="*")','read,search'),('(targetattr="description;lang-en")','write')],
    'w_deny_descopt':[('(targetattr="*")','read,search,write'),('(targetattr="description;lang-en")','DENYwrite')],
    # CAND-35: entry-level search and attribute-scoped denies
    'e_deny_noattr':[('(targetattr="*")',RSC),('','DENYsearch')],
    'e_deny_star':[('(targetattr="*")',RSC),('(targetattr="*")','DENYsearch')],
    'e_deny_notpw':[('(targetattr="*")',RSC),('(targetattr!="userPassword")','DENYsearch')],
    'e_deny_pwsn':[('(targetattr="*")',RSC),('(targetattr="userPassword || sn")','DENYsearch')],
    'e_deny_readstar':[('(targetattr="*")','search'),('(targetattr="*")','DENYread')],
    'e_allow_noattr':[('',RSC)],
    'e_allow_noattr_uid':[('',RSC),('(targetattr="uid")','read,search')],
  }
  ldif=f"dn: {P}\nobjectClass: organizationalUnit\nou: people\n\n"
  for s in acis: ldif+=f"dn: {who(s)}\nobjectClass: inetOrgPerson\nuid: {s}\ncn: {s}\nsn: S\nuserPassword: Probe-Pw-{s}-1\n\n"
  ldif+=f"dn: {B}\nobjectClass: organizationalUnit\nou: probe-fattr\n\n"
  for u,extra in [('fa_alice',''),('fa_bob','userPassword: Probe-Bob-Pw-1\nuid;x-test: bobtag\ndescription;lang-en: hello\n'),('fa_carol','description;lang-en;x-foo: multi\nuid;x-test;x-two: two\n')]:
    ldif+=f"dn: uid={u},{B}\nobjectClass: inetOrgPerson\nuid: {u}\ncn: {u}\nsn: S\n{extra}\n"
  r=ex('ldapadd','-x',*H,'-D','cn=Directory Manager','-w',pw,inp=ldif); print('add',r.returncode,r.stderr.strip()[:300])
  def addaci(text):
    r=ex('ldapmodify','-x',*H,'-D','cn=Directory Manager','-w',pw,inp=f"dn: {B}\nchangetype: modify\nadd: aci\naci: {text}\n\n")
    return r.returncode, r.stderr.strip().replace('\n',' ')[:200]
  # CAND-33: which targetattr names does 389 accept when the ACI is added?
  for k,ta in enumerate(['uid','UID','userid','uid;x-test','UID;X-TEST','uid;','fooBar','fooBar;x-test','2.5.4.4','2.5.4.4;x-test','1.2.3.4','0.9.2342.19200300.100.1.1',
      'pwdAccountLockedTime','pwdReset','pwdChangedTime','passwordHistory','pwdUpdateTime','nsAccountLock','entryUUID','memberOf','aci','nsUniqueId','entrydn',
      'person','inetOrgPerson','objectClass','telephoneNumber','mailAlternateAddress','nsds5ReplicaCredentials','userCertificate;binary','cn;lang-en;x-a','sn || fooBar','sn||cn','*']):
    for neg in ['','!']:
      rc,err=addaci(f'(target="ldap:///{B}")(targetattr{neg}="{ta}")(version 3.0; acl "labldap:v33-{k}{neg and "n"}"; allow (read) userdn="ldap:///{who("nobody")}";)')
      print(f'v33 targetattr{neg}="{ta}" rc={rc} {err}')
  rc,err=addaci(f'(target="ldap:///{B}")(version 3.0; acl "labldap:v33-noattr"; allow (read) userdn="ldap:///{who("nobody")}";)'); print('v33 (no targetattr) rc=',rc,err)
  for s_,lst in acis.items():
    for k,(t,perm) in enumerate(lst):
      act="deny ("+perm[4:]+")" if perm.startswith("DENY") else "allow ("+perm+")"
      print('aci',s_,k,*addaci(f'(target="ldap:///{B}"){t}(version 3.0; acl "labldap:{s_}-{k}"; {act} userdn="ldap:///{who(s_)}";)'))
  fl=['(uid=fa_bob)','(uid=bobtag)','(uid;x-test=bobtag)','(uid;X-TEST=bobtag)','(uid;x-test=two)','(uid;x-test;x-two=two)','(uid;x-two=two)','(!(uid;x-test=bobtag))',
      '(description=hello)','(description;lang-en=hello)','(description;lang-en=multi)','(description;lang-en;x-foo=multi)','(description;LANG-EN=hello)',
      '(sn=S)','(!(sn=X))','(userPassword=*)','(!(userPassword=*))','(objectClass=*)','(uid=*)']
  subs=[('DM','cn=Directory Manager',pw)]+[(s,who(s),f'Probe-Pw-{s}-1') for s in acis]
  for name,dn,p in subs:
    if name.startswith('w_'): continue
    for f in fl:
      r=ex('ldapsearch','-x','-LLL',*H,'-D',dn,'-w',p,'-b',B,'-s','one',f,'1.1')
      dns=sorted(l.split(',')[0][4:] for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if l.startswith('dn:'))
      print(f"{name:20} {f:40} rc={r.returncode} {dns} {r.stderr.strip()[:80]}")
    for f in ['(objectClass=*)','(uid;x-test=bobtag)','(sn=S)']:
      r=ex('ldapsearch','-x','-LLL','-o','ldif-wrap=no',*H,'-D',dn,'-w',p,'-b','uid=fa_bob,'+B,'-s','base',f,'uid','uid;x-test','description','description;lang-en','sn','userPassword')
      print(f"{name:20} BASE fa_bob {f:24} -> {[red(l) for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if l]} rc={r.returncode}")
    for a,v in [('uid;x-test','bobtag'),('uid','fa_bob'),('uid','bobtag'),('description;lang-en','hello'),('description','hello')]:
      r=ex('ldapcompare','-x',*H,'-D',dn,'-w',p,'uid=fa_bob,'+B,f'{a}:{v}')
      print(f"{name:20} COMPARE fa_bob {a}:{v} rc={r.returncode} {r.stdout.strip()[:40]} {r.stderr.strip()[:80]}")
  for name in ['w_descopt','w_deny_descopt']:
    dn,p=who(name),f'Probe-Pw-{name}-1'
    for a,v in [('description;lang-en','w1'),('description','w2'),('description;lang-en;x-foo','w3'),('description;LANG-EN','w4'),('sn','w5')]:
      r=ex('ldapmodify','-x',*H,'-D',dn,'-w',p,inp=f"dn: uid=fa_alice,{B}\nchangetype: modify\nadd: {a}\n{a}: {name}-{v}\n\n")
      print(f"{name:20} WRITE add {a} rc={r.returncode} {r.stderr.strip().replace(chr(10),' ')[:100]}")
  r=ex('ldapsearch','-x','-LLL','-o','ldif-wrap=no',*H,'-D','cn=Directory Manager','-w',pw,'-b','uid=fa_alice,'+B,'-s','base','(objectClass=*)','description','sn')
  print('DM alice after writes ->',[l for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if l])
finally:
  sp.run(['docker','rm','-f','-v',n],capture_output=True)

===== script filterprobe17.py =====
# Probe 17: every attributeType name, alias and OID in the pinned image's cn=schema (input for the native targetattr schema check, CAND-33).
import subprocess as sp, time, secrets, re
ref=open('deploy/docker/dirsrv.digest').read().strip()
pw=secrets.token_hex(16); n='muse-fprobe17-'+secrets.token_hex(3)
sp.run(['docker','run','-d','--name',n,'-e','DS_DM_PASSWORD='+pw,'-v','/data',ref],stdout=sp.DEVNULL,check=True)
try:
  for i in range(600):
    l=sp.run(['docker','logs',n],capture_output=True,text=True)
    if '389-ds-container started.' in l.stdout+l.stderr: break
    time.sleep(0.5)
  r=sp.run(['docker','exec',n,'ldapsearch','-x','-LLL','-o','ldif-wrap=no','-H','ldap://127.0.0.1:3389','-D','cn=Directory Manager','-w',pw,'-b','cn=schema','-s','base','(objectClass=*)','attributeTypes'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
  out=[]
  for line in r.stdout.splitlines():
    if not line.lower().startswith('attributetypes:'): continue
    body=line.split(':',1)[1].strip()
    m=re.match(r"\(\s*([0-9.]+|[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9-]*-oid)\s+NAME\s+(\(([^)]*)\)|'([^']*)')",body)
    if not m: print('UNPARSED',body[:120]); continue
    names=re.findall(r"'([^']+)'",m.group(2))
    out.append((m.group(1),names))
  print('# image',ref)
  print('# attributeTypes',len(out))
  for oid,names in sorted(out,key=lambda x:x[1][0].lower()):
    print(oid,' '.join(names))
finally:
  sp.run(['docker','rm','-f','-v',n],capture_output=True)

===== script filterprobe18.py =====
import subprocess as sp, time, secrets, re
ref=open('deploy/docker/dirsrv.digest').read().strip()
pw=secrets.token_hex(16); n='muse-fprobe18-'+secrets.token_hex(3)
def ex(*a, inp=None): return sp.run(['docker','exec','-i',n,*a],input=inp,capture_output=True,text=True)
sp.run(['docker','run','-d','--name',n,'-e','DS_DM_PASSWORD='+pw,'-v','/data',ref],stdout=sp.DEVNULL,check=True)
S='dc=example,dc=test'; B='ou=probe-fattr,'+S; P='ou=people,'+S
def who(u): return f'uid={u},{P}'
H=['-H','ldap://127.0.0.1:3389']
def red(t): return re.sub(r'(userPassword[^:]*::?) .*', r'\1 <redacted>', t)
try:
  for i in range(600):
    l=sp.run(['docker','logs',n],capture_output=True,text=True)
    if '389-ds-container started.' in l.stdout+l.stderr: break
    time.sleep(0.5)
  print('image',ref); print('backend',ex('dsconf','localhost','backend','create','--suffix',S,'--be-name','userroot','--create-suffix').returncode)
  RSC='read,search,compare'
  acis={
    't_deny_uidopt':[('(targetattr!="uid;x-test")',RSC)],
    't_uidsemi':[('(targetattr="uid;")',RSC)],
    'w_noattr':[('(targetattr="*")','read,search'),('','write')],
    'w_deny_noattr':[('(targetattr="*")','read,search,write'),('','DENYwrite')],
    'w_deny_descopt':[('(targetattr="*")','read,search,write'),('(targetattr="description;lang-en")','DENYwrite')],
    'w_deny_uid':[('(targetattr="*")','read,search,write'),('(targetattr="uid")','DENYwrite')],
    'w_none':[('(targetattr="*")','read,search')],
  }
  ldif=f"dn: {P}\nobjectClass: organizationalUnit\nou: people\n\n"
  for s in acis: ldif+=f"dn: {who(s)}\nobjectClass: inetOrgPerson\nuid: {s}\ncn: {s}\nsn: S\nuserPassword: Probe-Pw-{s}-1\n\n"
  ldif+=f"dn: {B}\nobjectClass: organizationalUnit\nou: probe-fattr\n\n"
  for u,extra in [('fa_alice',''),('fa_bob','userPassword: Probe-Bob-Pw-1\nuid;x-test: bobtag\ndescription;lang-en: hello\n'),('fa_carol','description;lang-en;x-foo: multi\nuid;x-test;x-two: two\n')]:
    ldif+=f"dn: uid={u},{B}\nobjectClass: inetOrgPerson\nuid: {u}\ncn: {u}\nsn: S\n{extra}\n"
  r=ex('ldapadd','-x',*H,'-D','cn=Directory Manager','-w',pw,inp=ldif); print('add',r.returncode,r.stderr.strip()[:300])
  def addaci(text):
    r=ex('ldapmodify','-x',*H,'-D','cn=Directory Manager','-w',pw,inp=f"dn: {B}\nchangetype: modify\nadd: aci\naci: {text}\n\n")
    return r.returncode, r.stderr.strip().replace('\n',' ')[:200]
  for s_,lst in acis.items():
    for k,(t,perm) in enumerate(lst):
      act="deny ("+perm[4:]+")" if perm.startswith("DENY") else "allow ("+perm+")"
      print('aci',s_,k,*addaci(f'(target="ldap:///{B}"){t}(version 3.0; acl "labldap:{s_}-{k}"; {act} userdn="ldap:///{who(s_)}";)'))
  fl=['(uid=fa_bob)','(uid=bobtag)','(uid;x-test=bobtag)','(uid;x-test;x-two=two)','(uid;x-two=two)','(uid=two)','(!(uid;x-test=bobtag))','(sn=S)']
  for name in ['t_deny_uidopt','t_uidsemi']:
    dn,p=who(name),f'Probe-Pw-{name}-1'
    for f in fl:
      r=ex('ldapsearch','-x','-LLL',*H,'-D',dn,'-w',p,'-b',B,'-s','one',f,'1.1')
      dns=sorted(l.split(',')[0][4:] for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if l.startswith('dn:'))
      print(f"{name:20} {f:40} rc={r.returncode} {dns}")
    r=ex('ldapsearch','-x','-LLL','-o','ldif-wrap=no',*H,'-D',dn,'-w',p,'-b',B,'-s','one','(sn=S)','uid','uid;x-test','uid;x-two')
    print(f"{name:20} READ one (sn=S) uid -> {[l for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if l]} rc={r.returncode}")
  def mod(name,ldif):
    r=ex('ldapmodify','-x',*H,'-D',who(name),'-w',f'Probe-Pw-{name}-1',inp=ldif); return r.returncode, r.stderr.strip().replace(chr(10),' ')[:110]
  for name in ['w_noattr','w_deny_noattr','w_deny_descopt','w_deny_uid','w_none']:
    print(f"{name:20} WRITE add sn", *mod(name,f"dn: uid=fa_alice,{B}\nchangetype: modify\nadd: sn\nsn: {name}\n\n"))
    print(f"{name:20} WRITE missing-dn add sn", *mod(name,f"dn: uid=nobody,{B}\nchangetype: modify\nadd: sn\nsn: {name}\n\n"))
    print(f"{name:20} WRITE empty-change replace none", *mod(name,f"dn: uid=fa_alice,{B}\nchangetype: modify\nreplace: description;x-none\n\n"))
  for name,old,new in [('w_deny_descopt','fa_carol','fa_carol2'),('w_deny_uid','fa_alice','fa_alice2'),('w_noattr','fa_bob','fa_bob2'),('w_none','fa_bob','fa_bob3')]:
    print(f"{name:20} MODRDN uid={old} -> uid={new}", *mod(name,f"dn: uid={old},{B}\nchangetype: modrdn\nnewrdn: uid={new}\ndeleteoldrdn: 1\n\n"))
  r=ex('ldapsearch','-x','-LLL',*H,'-D','cn=Directory Manager','-w',pw,'-b',B,'-s','one','(objectClass=*)','1.1'); print('DM after', sorted(l for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if l))
finally:
  sp.run(['docker','rm','-f','-v',n],capture_output=True)

===== script filterprobe19.py =====
import subprocess as sp, time, secrets, re
ref=open('deploy/docker/dirsrv.digest').read().strip()
pw=secrets.token_hex(16); n='muse-fprobe19-'+secrets.token_hex(3)

S='dc=example,dc=test'; B='ou=probe-fattr,'+S; P='ou=people,'+S
def who(u): return f'uid={u},{P}'
H=['-H','ldap://127.0.0.1:3389']
def red(t): return re.sub(r'(userPassword[^:]*::?) .*', r'\1 <redacted>', t)
try:
  for i in range(600):
    l=sp.run(['docker','logs',n],capture_output=True,text=True)
    if '389-ds-container started.' in l.stdout+l.stderr: break
    time.sleep(0.5)
  print('image',ref); print('backend',ex('dsconf','localhost','backend','create','--suffix',S,'--be-name','userroot','--create-suffix').returncode)
  RSC='read,search,compare'
  acis={
    'p_star_read':[('(targetattr="*")','read')],
    'e_deny_star':[('(targetattr="*")',RSC),('(targetattr="*")','DENYsearch')],
    'e_allow_noattr':[('',RSC)],
    'p_star_rsc':[('(targetattr="*")',RSC)],
    'r_noattr_wa':[('(targetattr="*")','read,search'),('','write,add')],
  }
  ldif=f"dn: {P}\nobjectClass: organizationalUnit\nou: people\n\n"
  for s in acis: ldif+=f"dn: {who(s)}\nobjectClass: inetOrgPerson\nuid: {s}\ncn: {s}\nsn: S\nuserPassword: Probe-Pw-{s}-1\n\n"
  ldif+=f"dn: {B}\nobjectClass: organizationalUnit\nou: probe-fattr\n\n"
  for u,extra in [('fa_alice',''),('fa_bob','userPassword: Probe-Bob-Pw-1\nuid;x-test: bobtag\ndescription;lang-en: hello\n'),('fa_carol','description;lang-en;x-foo: multi\nuid;x-test;x-two: two\n')]:
    ldif+=f"dn: uid={u},{B}\nobjectClass: inetOrgPerson\nuid: {u}\ncn: {u}\nsn: S\n{extra}\n"
  r=ex('ldapadd','-x',*H,'-D','cn=Directory Manager','-w',pw,inp=ldif); print('add',r.returncode,r.stderr.strip()[:300])
  def addaci(text):
    r=ex('ldapmodify','-x',*H,'-D','cn=Directory Manager','-w',pw,inp=f"dn: {B}\nchangetype: modify\nadd: aci\naci: {text}\n\n")
    return r.returncode, r.stderr.strip().replace('\n',' ')[:200]
  for s_,lst in acis.items():
    for k,(t,perm) in enumerate(lst):
      act="deny ("+perm[4:]+")" if perm.startswith("DENY") else "allow ("+perm+")"
      print('aci',s_,k,*addaci(f'(target="ldap:///{B}"){t}(version 3.0; acl "labldap:{s_}-{k}"; {act} userdn="ldap:///{who(s_)}";)'))
  for k,ta in enumerate(['allowWeakCipher-oid','nsAdminDomainName-oid','2.5.4.4;','uid;;x-test']):
    rc,err=addaci(f'(target="ldap:///{B}")(targetattr="{ta}")(version 3.0; acl "labldap:v19-{k}"; allow (read) userdn="ldap:///{who("nobody")}";)')
    print(f'v19 targetattr="{ta}" rc={rc} {err}')
  for name in ['p_star_read','e_deny_star','e_allow_noattr','p_star_rsc']:
    dn,p=who(name),f'Probe-Pw-{name}-1'
    for f in ['(&)','(!(|))','(|)','(sn=S)']:
      for scope,base in [('one',B),('base','uid=fa_bob,'+B)]:
        r=ex('ldapsearch','-x','-LLL',*H,'-D',dn,'-w',p,'-b',base,'-s',scope,f,'1.1')
        dns=sorted(l.split(',')[0][4:] for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if l.startswith('dn:'))
        print(f"{name:16} {scope:4} {f:10} rc={r.returncode} {dns} {r.stderr.strip()[:80]}")
  def mod(name,ldif):
    r=ex('ldapmodify','-x',*H,'-D',who(name),'-w',f'Probe-Pw-{name}-1',inp=ldif); return r.returncode, r.stderr.strip().replace(chr(10),' ')[:110]
  print('r_noattr_wa MODRDN uid=fa_bob -> uid=fa_bob2', *mod('r_noattr_wa',f"dn: uid=fa_bob,{B}\nchangetype: modrdn\nnewrdn: uid=fa_bob2\ndeleteoldrdn: 1\n\n"))
  print('r_noattr_wa WRITE add sn', *mod('r_noattr_wa',f"dn: uid=fa_alice,{B}\nchangetype: modify\nadd: sn\nsn: x\n\n"))
finally:
  sp.run(['docker','rm','-f','-v',n],capture_output=True)

===== script filterprobe20.py =====
import subprocess as sp, time, secrets, re
ref=open('deploy/docker/dirsrv.digest').read().strip()
pw=secrets.token_hex(16); n='muse-fprobe20-'+secrets.token_hex(3)
def ex(*a, inp=None): return sp.run(['docker','exec','-i',n,*a],input=inp,capture_output=True,text=True)
sp.run(['docker','run','-d','--name',n,'-e','DS_DM_PASSWORD='+pw,'-v','/data',ref],stdout=sp.DEVNULL,check=True)
S='dc=example,dc=test'; B='ou=probe-fattr,'+S; P='ou=people,'+S
def who(u): return f'uid={u},{P}'
H=['-H','ldap://127.0.0.1:3389']
def red(t): return re.sub(r'(userPassword[^:]*::?) .*', r'\1 <redacted>', t)
try:
  for i in range(600):
    l=sp.run(['docker','logs',n],capture_output=True,text=True)
    if '389-ds-container started.' in l.stdout+l.stderr: break
    time.sleep(0.5)
  print('image',ref); print('backend',ex('dsconf','localhost','backend','create','--suffix',S,'--be-name','userroot','--create-suffix').returncode)
  RSC='read,search,compare'
  acis={
    'i_uid_rs':[('(targetattr="uid")','read,search')],
    'i_userid_rs':[('(targetattr="userid")','read,search')],
    'i_cn_rs':[('(targetattr="cn")','read,search')],
    'i_star_rsc':[('(targetattr="*")',RSC)],
  }
  ldif=f"dn: {P}\nobjectClass: organizationalUnit\nou: people\n\n"
  for s in acis: ldif+=f"dn: {who(s)}\nobjectClass: inetOrgPerson\nuid: {s}\ncn: {s}\nsn: S\nuserPassword: Probe-Pw-{s}-1\n\n"
  ldif+=f"dn: {B}\nobjectClass: organizationalUnit\nou: probe-fattr\n\n"
  for u,extra in [('fa_alice',''),('fa_bob','userPassword: Probe-Bob-Pw-1\nuid;x-test: bobtag\ndescription;lang-en: hello\n'),('fa_carol','description;lang-en;x-foo: multi\nuid;x-test;x-two: two\n')]:
    ldif+=f"dn: uid={u},{B}\nobjectClass: inetOrgPerson\nuid: {u}\ncn: {u}\nsn: S\n{extra}\n"
  r=ex('ldapadd','-x',*H,'-D','cn=Directory Manager','-w',pw,inp=ldif); print('add',r.returncode,r.stderr.strip()[:300])
  def addaci(text):
    r=ex('ldapmodify','-x',*H,'-D','cn=Directory Manager','-w',pw,inp=f"dn: {B}\nchangetype: modify\nadd: aci\naci: {text}\n\n")
    return r.returncode, r.stderr.strip().replace('\n',' ')[:200]
  for s_,lst in acis.items():
    for k,(t,perm) in enumerate(lst):
      act="deny ("+perm[4:]+")" if perm.startswith("DENY") else "allow ("+perm+")"
      print('aci',s_,k,*addaci(f'(target="ldap:///{B}"){t}(version 3.0; acl "labldap:{s_}-{k}"; {act} userdn="ldap:///{who(s_)}";)'))
  r=ex('ldapadd','-x',*H,'-D','cn=Directory Manager','-w',pw,inp=f"dn: userid=v_u,{B}\nobjectClass: inetOrgPerson\nuserid: v_u\ncommonName: v_u\nsurname: S\ncn;lang-en: en_u\n\n")
  print('add userid-spelled entry',r.returncode,r.stderr.strip()[:200])
  r=ex('ldapsearch','-x','-LLL','-o','ldif-wrap=no',*H,'-D','cn=Directory Manager','-w',pw,'-b',B,'-s','one','(cn=v_u)','*')
  print('DM stored spelling:',[l for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if l])
  for name in ['DM']+list(acis):
    dn,p=(('cn=Directory Manager',pw) if name=='DM' else (who(name),f'Probe-Pw-{name}-1'))
    for f in ['(uid=v_u)','(userid=v_u)','(cn=v_u)','(cn;=v_u)','(cn;=en_u)','(cn=en_u)','(cn;lang-en=en_u)','(cn;lang-en;=en_u)','(uid;=v_u)','(cn;=fa_bob)']:
      r=ex('ldapsearch','-x','-LLL','-o','ldif-wrap=no',*H,'-D',dn,'-w',p,'-b',B,'-s','one',f,'uid','cn')
      out=[l for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if l and not l.startswith('dn:')]
      dns=sorted(l.split(',')[0] for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if l.startswith('dn:'))
      print(f"{name:12} {f:20} rc={r.returncode} {dns} {out} {r.stderr.strip()[:80]}")
    r=ex('ldapcompare','-x',*H,'-D',dn,'-w',p,f'uid=v_u,{B}','uid:v_u'); print(f"{name:12} COMPARE uid:v_u rc={r.returncode} {r.stdout.strip()} {r.stderr.strip()[:60]}")
    r=ex('ldapcompare','-x',*H,'-D',dn,'-w',p,f'uid=v_u,{B}','cn;:v_u'); print(f"{name:12} COMPARE cn;:v_u rc={r.returncode} {r.stdout.strip()} {r.stderr.strip()[:60]}")
finally:
  sp.run(['docker','rm','-f','-v',n],capture_output=True)

===== script filterprobe20b.py =====
import subprocess as sp, time, secrets, re
ref=open('deploy/docker/dirsrv.digest').read().strip()
pw=secrets.token_hex(16); n='muse-fprobe20b-'+secrets.token_hex(3)
def ex(*a, inp=None): return sp.run(['docker','exec','-i',n,*a],input=inp,capture_output=True,text=True)
sp.run(['docker','run','-d','--name',n,'-e','DS_DM_PASSWORD='+pw,'-v','/data',ref],stdout=sp.DEVNULL,check=True)
S='dc=example,dc=test'; B='ou=probe-fattr,'+S; P='ou=people,'+S
def who(u): return f'uid={u},{P}'
H=['-H','ldap://127.0.0.1:3389']
def red(t): return re.sub(r'(userPassword[^:]*::?) .*', r'\1 <redacted>', t)
try:
  for i in range(600):
    l=sp.run(['docker','logs',n],capture_output=True,text=True)
    if '389-ds-container started.' in l.stdout+l.stderr: break
    time.sleep(0.5)
  print('image',ref); print('backend',ex('dsconf','localhost','backend','create','--suffix',S,'--be-name','userroot','--create-suffix').returncode)
  RSC='read,search,compare'
  acis={
    'i_uid_rs':[('(targetattr="uid")','read,search')],
    'i_userid_rs':[('(targetattr="userid")','read,search')],
    'i_cn_rs':[('(targetattr="cn")','read,search')],
    'i_star_rsc':[('(targetattr="*")',RSC)],
  }
  ldif=f"dn: {P}\nobjectClass: organizationalUnit\nou: people\n\n"
  for s in acis: ldif+=f"dn: {who(s)}\nobjectClass: inetOrgPerson\nuid: {s}\ncn: {s}\nsn: S\nuserPassword: Probe-Pw-{s}-1\n\n"
  ldif+=f"dn: {B}\nobjectClass: organizationalUnit\nou: probe-fattr\n\n"
  for u,extra in [('fa_alice',''),('fa_bob','userPassword: Probe-Bob-Pw-1\nuid;x-test: bobtag\ndescription;lang-en: hello\n'),('fa_carol','description;lang-en;x-foo: multi\nuid;x-test;x-two: two\n')]:
    ldif+=f"dn: uid={u},{B}\nobjectClass: inetOrgPerson\nuid: {u}\ncn: {u}\nsn: S\n{extra}\n"
  r=ex('ldapadd','-x',*H,'-D','cn=Directory Manager','-w',pw,inp=ldif); print('add',r.returncode,r.stderr.strip()[:300])
  def addaci(text):
    r=ex('ldapmodify','-x',*H,'-D','cn=Directory Manager','-w',pw,inp=f"dn: {B}\nchangetype: modify\nadd: aci\naci: {text}\n\n")
    return r.returncode, r.stderr.strip().replace('\n',' ')[:200]
  for s_,lst in acis.items():
    for k,(t,perm) in enumerate(lst):
      act="deny ("+perm[4:]+")" if perm.startswith("DENY") else "allow ("+perm+")"
      print('aci',s_,k,*addaci(f'(target="ldap:///{B}"){t}(version 3.0; acl "labldap:{s_}-{k}"; {act} userdn="ldap:///{who(s_)}";)'))
  r=ex('ldapadd','-x',*H,'-D','cn=Directory Manager','-w',pw,inp=f"dn: userid=v_u,{B}\nobjectClass: inetOrgPerson\nuserid: v_u\ncommonName: v_u\nsurname: S\ncn;lang-en: en_u\n\n")
  print('add userid-spelled entry',r.returncode,r.stderr.strip()[:200])
  r=ex('ldapsearch','-x','-LLL','-o','ldif-wrap=no',*H,'-D','cn=Directory Manager','-w',pw,'-b',B,'-s','one','(cn=v_u)','*')
  print('DM stored spelling:',[l for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if l])
  open('/tmp/_r','w')
  sp.run(['docker','cp','/tmp/rawldap.py',n+':/tmp/rawldap.py'])
  F=['cn;=v_u','cn;=en_u','cn;lang-en;=en_u','uid;=v_u','cn;LANG-EN=en_u','cn=v_u']
  for name in ['DM','i_cn_rs','i_star_rsc']:
    dn,p=(('cn=Directory Manager',pw) if name=='DM' else (who(name),f'Probe-Pw-{name}-1'))
    r=ex('python3','/tmp/rawldap.py','127.0.0.1','3389',dn,p,B,*F)
    print(name, r.stdout.strip().replace(chr(10),' | '), r.stderr.strip()[-200:])
finally:
  sp.run(['docker','rm','-f','-v',n],capture_output=True)

===== script rawldap.py (probe 20b helper, run inside the container) =====
import socket,sys
def L(n):
    if n<128: return bytes([n])
    b=n.to_bytes((n.bit_length()+7)//8,'big'); return bytes([0x80|len(b)])+b
def T(t,v): return bytes([t])+L(len(v))+v
def I(n): return T(0x02,bytes([n]))
def S(s): return T(0x04,s.encode())
def rd(sk):
    h=sk.recv(2)
    if not h: return None
    n=h[1]
    if n&0x80:
        k=n&0x7f; n=int.from_bytes(sk.recv(k),'big')
    b=b''
    while len(b)<n: b+=sk.recv(n-len(b))
    return h[0],b
host,port,dn,pw,base=sys.argv[1:6]
sk=socket.create_connection((host,int(port)))
sk.send(T(0x30,I(1)+T(0x60,I(3)+S(dn)+T(0x80,pw.encode()))))
t,b=rd(sk); print('bind resp',b[-12:].hex())
for i,(attr,val) in enumerate([(a.split('=')[0],a.split('=')[1]) for a in sys.argv[6:]]):
    flt=T(0xa3,S(attr)+S(val))
    req=T(0x63,S(base)+T(0x0a,b'\x01')+T(0x0a,b'\x00')+I(0)+I(0)+T(0x01,b'\x00')+flt+T(0x30,S('1.1')))
    sk.send(T(0x30,I(2+i)+req))
    dns=[];
    while True:
        t,b=rd(sk)
        # find op tag: after msgid
        j=2+b[1]; op=b[j]
        if op==0x64:
            k=j+1; ln=b[k]; k+=1
            if ln&0x80: k+=ln&0x7f
            dl=b[k+1]; dns.append(b[k+2:k+2+dl].decode().split(',')[0])
        elif op==0x65:
            k=j+1; ln=b[k]; k+=1
            if ln&0x80: k+=ln&0x7f
            print(f'({attr}={val}) entries={dns} result={b[k+2]}'); break

===== script filterprobe21.py =====
import subprocess as sp, time, secrets, re
ref=open('deploy/docker/dirsrv.digest').read().strip()
pw=secrets.token_hex(16); n='muse-fprobe21-'+secrets.token_hex(3)
def ex(*a, inp=None): return sp.run(['docker','exec','-i',n,*a],input=inp,capture_output=True,text=True)
sp.run(['docker','run','-d','--name',n,'-e','DS_DM_PASSWORD='+pw,'-v','/data',ref],stdout=sp.DEVNULL,check=True)
S='dc=example,dc=test'; B='ou=probe-fattr,'+S; P='ou=people,'+S
def who(u): return f'uid={u},{P}'
H=['-H','ldap://127.0.0.1:3389']
def red(t): return re.sub(r'(userPassword[^:]*::?) .*', r'\1 <redacted>', t)
try:
  for i in range(600):
    l=sp.run(['docker','logs',n],capture_output=True,text=True)
    if '389-ds-container started.' in l.stdout+l.stderr: break
    time.sleep(0.5)
  print('image',ref); print('backend',ex('dsconf','localhost','backend','create','--suffix',S,'--be-name','userroot','--create-suffix').returncode)
  RSC='read,search,compare'
  def addaci(dn,text):
    r=ex('ldapmodify','-x',*H,'-D','cn=Directory Manager','-w',pw,inp=f"dn: {dn}\nchangetype: modify\nadd: aci\naci: {text}\n\n")
    return r.returncode, r.stderr.strip().replace('\n',' ')[:200]
  subs=['sfx_before','sfx_after','ou_after']
  ldif=f"dn: {P}\nobjectClass: organizationalUnit\nou: people\n\n"
  for s_ in subs: ldif+=f"dn: {who(s_)}\nobjectClass: inetOrgPerson\nuid: {s_}\ncn: {s_}\nsn: S\nuserPassword: Probe-Pw-{s_}-1\n\n"
  r=ex('ldapadd','-x',*H,'-D','cn=Directory Manager','-w',pw,inp=ldif); print('add people',r.returncode)
  T=lambda s_: f'(target="ldap:///{B}")(targetattr="uid;x-test")(version 3.0; acl "labldap:{s_}"; allow (read,search,compare) userdn="ldap:///{who(s_)}";)'
  print('aci sfx_before', *addaci(S,T('sfx_before')))
  ldif=f"dn: {B}\nobjectClass: organizationalUnit\nou: probe-fattr\n\n"
  for u,extra in [('fa_alice',''),('fa_bob','uid;x-test: bobtag\n'),('fa_carol','uid;x-test;x-two: two\n')]:
    ldif+=f"dn: uid={u},{B}\nobjectClass: inetOrgPerson\nuid: {u}\ncn: {u}\nsn: S\n{extra}\n"
  r=ex('ldapadd','-x',*H,'-D','cn=Directory Manager','-w',pw,inp=ldif); print('add',r.returncode,r.stderr.strip()[:300])
  print('aci sfx_after', *addaci(S,T('sfx_after')))
  print('aci ou_after', *addaci(B,T('ou_after')))
  for s_ in subs:
    for f in ['(uid;x-test=bobtag)','(uid;x-test=two)','(uid=fa_bob)']:
      r=ex('ldapsearch','-x','-LLL',*H,'-D',who(s_),'-w',f'Probe-Pw-{s_}-1','-b',B,'-s','one',f,'1.1')
      dns=sorted(l.split(',')[0][4:] for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if l.startswith('dn:'))
      print(f"{s_:12} {f:22} rc={r.returncode} {dns}")
finally:
  sp.run(['docker','rm','-f','-v',n],capture_output=True)

===== script filterprobe22.py =====
import subprocess as sp, time, secrets, re
ref=open('deploy/docker/dirsrv.digest').read().strip()
pw=secrets.token_hex(16); n='muse-fprobe22-'+secrets.token_hex(3)

S='dc=example,dc=test'; B='ou=probe-fattr,'+S; P='ou=people,'+S
def who(u): return f'uid={u},{P}'
H=['-H','ldap://127.0.0.1:3389']
def red(t): return re.sub(r'(userPassword[^:]*::?) .*', r'\1 <redacted>', t)
try:
  for i in range(600):
    l=sp.run(['docker','logs',n],capture_output=True,text=True)
    if '389-ds-container started.' in l.stdout+l.stderr: break
    time.sleep(0.5)
  print('image',ref); print('backend',ex('dsconf','localhost','backend','create','--suffix',S,'--be-name','userroot','--create-suffix').returncode)
  RSC='read,search,compare'
  def addaci(dn,text):
    r=ex('ldapmodify','-x',*H,'-D','cn=Directory Manager','-w',pw,inp=f"dn: {dn}\nchangetype: modify\nadd: aci\naci: {text}\n\n")
    return r.returncode, r.stderr.strip().replace('\n',' ')[:200]
  subs=['sfx_before','sfx_after','ou_after']
  ldif=f"dn: {P}\nobjectClass: organizationalUnit\nou: people\n\n"
  for s_ in subs: ldif+=f"dn: {who(s_)}\nobjectClass: inetOrgPerson\nuid: {s_}\ncn: {s_}\nsn: S\nuserPassword: Probe-Pw-{s_}-1\n\n"
  r=ex('ldapadd','-x',*H,'-D','cn=Directory Manager','-w',pw,inp=ldif); print('add people',r.returncode)
  T=lambda s_: f'(target="ldap:///{B}")(targetattr="uid;x-test")(version 3.0; acl "labldap:{s_}"; allow (read,search,compare) userdn="ldap:///{who(s_)}";)'
  print('aci sfx_before', *addaci(S,T('sfx_before')))
  ldif=f"dn: {B}\nobjectClass: organizationalUnit\nou: probe-fattr\n\n"
  for u,extra in [('fa_alice',''),('fa_bob','uid;x-test: bobtag\n'),('fa_carol','uid;x-test;x-two: two\n')]:
    ldif+=f"dn: uid={u},{B}\nobjectClass: inetOrgPerson\nuid: {u}\ncn: {u}\nsn: S\n{extra}\n"
  r=ex('ldapadd','-x',*H,'-D','cn=Directory Manager','-w',pw,inp=ldif); print('add',r.returncode,r.stderr.strip()[:300])
  print('aci sfx_after', *addaci(S,T('sfx_after')))
  print('aci ou_after', *addaci(B,T('ou_after')))
  ip=sp.run(['docker','inspect','-f','{{range .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{.IPAddress}}{{end}}',n],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()
  open('/tmp/probe22.env','w').write(f"{ip}\n{n}\n")
  r=sp.run(['go','run','./tmpprobe22',ip,who('ou_after'),'Probe-Pw-ou_after-1',B],capture_output=True,text=True,cwd='.')
  print(r.stdout, r.stderr[-800:])
  r=sp.run(['go','run','./tmpprobe22',ip,'cn=Directory Manager',pw,B,'add'],capture_output=True,text=True,cwd='.')
  print('DM-add', r.stdout, r.stderr[-800:])
  r=sp.run(['go','run','./tmpprobe22',ip,who('ou_after'),'Probe-Pw-ou_after-1',B],capture_output=True,text=True,cwd='.')
  print('after go add', r.stdout, r.stderr[-800:])
  r=ex('ldapsearch','-x','-LLL','-o','ldif-wrap=no',*H,'-D','cn=Directory Manager','-w',pw,'-b',B,'-s','one','(uid=g_*)','*')
  print('stored', r.stdout)
finally:
  sp.run(['docker','rm','-f','-v',n],capture_output=True)

===== script filterprobe23.py =====
import subprocess as sp, time, secrets, re
ref=open('deploy/docker/dirsrv.digest').read().strip()
pw=secrets.token_hex(16); n='muse-fprobe23-'+secrets.token_hex(3)
def ex(*a, inp=None): return sp.run(['docker','exec','-i',n,*a],input=inp,capture_output=True,text=True)
sp.run(['docker','run','-d','--name',n,'-e','DS_DM_PASSWORD='+pw,'-v','/data',ref],stdout=sp.DEVNULL,check=True)
S='dc=example,dc=test'; B='ou=probe-fattr,'+S; P='ou=people,'+S
def who(u): return f'uid={u},{P}'
H=['-H','ldap://127.0.0.1:3389']
def red(t): return re.sub(r'(userPassword[^:]*::?) .*', r'\1 <redacted>', t)
try:
  for i in range(600):
    l=sp.run(['docker','logs',n],capture_output=True,text=True)
    if '389-ds-container started.' in l.stdout+l.stderr: break
    time.sleep(0.5)
  print('image',ref); print('backend',ex('dsconf','localhost','backend','create','--suffix',S,'--be-name','userroot','--create-suffix').returncode)
  RSC='read,search,compare'
  import sys
  variant=sys.argv[1]
  acis={
    'd_uidopt':[('(targetattr="*")',RSC),('(targetattr="uid;x-test")','DENY'+RSC)],
    't_deny_uidopt':[('(targetattr!="uid;x-test")',RSC)],
    't_uidopt':[('(targetattr="uid;x-test")',RSC)],
  }
  if variant=='semi': acis['t_uidsemi']=[('(targetattr="uid;")',RSC)]
  ldif=f"dn: {P}\nobjectClass: organizationalUnit\nou: people\n\n"
  for s in acis: ldif+=f"dn: {who(s)}\nobjectClass: inetOrgPerson\nuid: {s}\ncn: {s}\nsn: S\nuserPassword: Probe-Pw-{s}-1\n\n"
  ldif+=f"dn: {B}\nobjectClass: organizationalUnit\nou: probe-fattr\n\n"
  for u,extra in [('fa_alice',''),('fa_bob','userPassword: Probe-Bob-Pw-1\nuid;x-test: bobtag\ndescription;lang-en: hello\n'),('fa_carol','description;lang-en;x-foo: multi\nuid;x-test;x-two: two\n')]:
    ldif+=f"dn: uid={u},{B}\nobjectClass: inetOrgPerson\nuid: {u}\ncn: {u}\nsn: S\n{extra}\n"
  r=ex('ldapadd','-x',*H,'-D','cn=Directory Manager','-w',pw,inp=ldif); print('add',r.returncode,r.stderr.strip()[:300])
  def addaci(text):
    r=ex('ldapmodify','-x',*H,'-D','cn=Directory Manager','-w',pw,inp=f"dn: {B}\nchangetype: modify\nadd: aci\naci: {text}\n\n")
    return r.returncode, r.stderr.strip().replace('\n',' ')[:200]
  for s_,lst in acis.items():
    for k,(t,perm) in enumerate(lst):
      act="deny ("+perm[4:]+")" if perm.startswith("DENY") else "allow ("+perm+")"
      print('aci',s_,k,*addaci(f'(target="ldap:///{B}"){t}(version 3.0; acl "labldap:{s_}-{k}"; {act} userdn="ldap:///{who(s_)}";)'))
  print('variant',variant)
  for name in acis:
    for f in ['(uid;x-test=bobtag)','(uid;x-test=two)','(uid=fa_bob)']:
      r=ex('ldapsearch','-x','-LLL',*H,'-D',who(name),'-w',f'Probe-Pw-{name}-1','-b',B,'-s','one',f,'1.1')
      dns=sorted(l.split(',')[0][4:] for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if l.startswith('dn:'))
      print(f"{name:14} {f:22} rc={r.returncode} {dns}")
finally:
  sp.run(['docker','rm','-f','-v',n],capture_output=True)

===== script filterprobe24.py =====
import subprocess as sp, time, secrets, re
ref=open('deploy/docker/dirsrv.digest').read().strip()
pw=secrets.token_hex(16); n='muse-fprobe24-'+secrets.token_hex(3)
def ex(*a, inp=None): return sp.run(['docker','exec','-i',n,*a],input=inp,capture_output=True,text=True)
sp.run(['docker','run','-d','--name',n,'-e','DS_DM_PASSWORD='+pw,'-v','/data',ref],stdout=sp.DEVNULL,check=True)
S='dc=example,dc=test'; B='ou=probe-fattr,'+S; P='ou=people,'+S
def who(u): return f'uid={u},{P}'
H=['-H','ldap://127.0.0.1:3389']
def red(t): return re.sub(r'(userPassword[^:]*::?) .*', r'\1 <redacted>', t)
try:
  for i in range(600):
    l=sp.run(['docker','logs',n],capture_output=True,text=True)
    if '389-ds-container started.' in l.stdout+l.stderr: break
    time.sleep(0.5)
  print('image',ref); print('backend',ex('dsconf','localhost','backend','create','--suffix',S,'--be-name','userroot','--create-suffix').returncode)
  RSC='read,search,compare'
  import sys
  variant=sys.argv[1]
  acis={
    'd_uidopt':[('(targetattr="*")',RSC),('(targetattr="uid;x-test")','DENY'+RSC)],
    't_deny_uidopt':[('(targetattr!="uid;x-test")',RSC)],
    't_uidopt':[('(targetattr="uid;x-test")',RSC)],
  }
  if variant=='semi': acis['t_uidsemi']=[('(targetattr="uid;")',RSC)]
  ldif=f"dn: {P}\nobjectClass: organizationalUnit\nou: people\n\n"
  for s in acis: ldif+=f"dn: {who(s)}\nobjectClass: inetOrgPerson\nuid: {s}\ncn: {s}\nsn: S\nuserPassword: Probe-Pw-{s}-1\n\n"
  ldif+=f"dn: {B}\nobjectClass: organizationalUnit\nou: probe-fattr\n\n"
  for u,extra in [('fa_alice',''),('fa_bob','userPassword: Probe-Bob-Pw-1\nuid;x-test: bobtag\ndescription;lang-en: hello\n'),('fa_carol','description;lang-en;x-foo: multi\nuid;x-test;x-two: two\n')]:
    ldif+=f"dn: uid={u},{B}\nobjectClass: inetOrgPerson\nuid: {u}\ncn: {u}\nsn: S\n{extra}\n"
  r=ex('ldapadd','-x',*H,'-D','cn=Directory Manager','-w',pw,inp=ldif); print('add',r.returncode,r.stderr.strip()[:300])
  def addaci(text):
    r=ex('ldapmodify','-x',*H,'-D','cn=Directory Manager','-w',pw,inp=f"dn: {B}\nchangetype: modify\nadd: aci\naci: {text}\n\n")
    return r.returncode, r.stderr.strip().replace('\n',' ')[:200]
  for s_,lst in acis.items():
    for k,(t,perm) in enumerate(lst):
      act="deny ("+perm[4:]+")" if perm.startswith("DENY") else "allow ("+perm+")"
      print('aci',s_,k,*addaci(f'(target="ldap:///{B}"){t}(version 3.0; acl "labldap:{s_}-{k}"; {act} userdn="ldap:///{who(s_)}";)'))
  ip=sp.run(['docker','inspect','-f','{{range .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{.IPAddress}}{{end}}',n],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()
  for name in acis:
    for order in ['plain-first','opt-first']:
      fl=['(uid=fa_bob)','(uid;x-test=bobtag)','(uid;x-test=two)'] if order=='plain-first' else ['(uid;x-test=bobtag)','(uid;x-test=two)','(uid=fa_bob)']
      r=sp.run(['go','run','./tmpprobe24',ip,who(name),f'Probe-Pw-{name}-1',B,*fl],capture_output=True,text=True,cwd='.')
      print(f"{name:14} same-conn {order}: {r.stdout.strip()} {r.stderr[-300:]}")
finally:
  sp.run(['docker','rm','-f','-v',n],capture_output=True)

===== go helper for probe 24 (tmpprobe24/main.go, run from the repo root, then removed) =====
// Binds as os.Args[2] and runs each filter in os.Args[5:] in order on ONE connection
// (one-level search under os.Args[4], attributes 1.1), printing filter=[rdn values].
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strings"

	ldap "github.com/go-ldap/ldap/v3"
)

func main() {
	ip, dn, pw, base := os.Args[1], os.Args[2], os.Args[3], os.Args[4]
	c, err := ldap.DialURL("ldap://" + ip + ":3389")
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println("dial", err)
		return
	}
	if err := c.Bind(dn, pw); err != nil {
		fmt.Println("bind", err)
		return
	}
	var out []string
	for _, f := range os.Args[5:] {
		res, err := c.Search(ldap.NewSearchRequest(base, ldap.ScopeSingleLevel, ldap.NeverDerefAliases, 0, 0, false, f, []string{"1.1"}, nil))
		var got []string
		if res != nil {
			for _, e := range res.Entries {
				got = append(got, strings.TrimPrefix(strings.Split(e.DN, ",")[0], "uid="))
			}
		}
		out = append(out, fmt.Sprintf("%s=%v%v", f, got, map[bool]string{true: "", false: fmt.Sprint(err)}[err == nil]))
	}
	fmt.Println(strings.Join(out, " "))
}
